QuestInfo.name: What Sen wants to eat
QuestInfo.1: #b#p4##k is wondering what to make her brother, #b#p5##k, for dinner. Go talk to #b#p5##k, who's in the house next to #b#p4##k, and ask him what he wants to eat.
QuestInfo.2: You asked #b#p5##k, #b#p4##k's brother, what he wants for dinner. He said he wants #bMushroom Soup#k.

0.0: Oh, a traveler! Nice, right on time... I have a favor to ask. Head towards your right and you'll find a kid there.
0.1: That's my little brother, #b#p5##k. Will you please ask him what he wants for dinner?

no.0: Oh, I guess you're very busy. Still, it's not too difficult of a job, so please help if you can.

npc.0: You didn't talk to #b#p5##k yet? Please, open your eyes!
